create_train_state: create and initialize a Flax model train state with optimizer, EMA params, and metrics class
train_and_evaluate: run a distributed JAX training and evaluation loop with checkpointing, logging, and sampling
train_step: perform a single distributed training step with gradient accumulation and EMA updates
evaluate: evaluate a trained model on a dataset and aggregate metrics across steps
get_learning_rate: compute a cosine or constant learning rate with warmup for a given training step
